scope: Composited recuts of existing project footage. No pixels were generated by this batch.

temporal_flicker.calibratedOn: VYREALM_ANIME_HERO_5S.mp4 0.9803 (accepted); VYREALM_RAINLINE_TRAILER_1080P.mp4 shot 2 0.9030 (bad on every axis), shots 1/3 0.9814/0.9771
temporal_flicker.note: Confounded with motion: apply only when flowTop5Pct mean is below about 5, else morphing_geometry carries the signal.

motion_stall.calibratedOn: Both sample clips measured 0 exact and 0 near-duplicate pairs, longest run 0; thresholds set from the failure definition, not from an observed positive
motion_stall.note: No positive example in our corpus yet. Detection reliability is near-perfect by construction; the CUT POINT is the guess.

dead_footage.calibratedOn: VYREALM_ANIME_HERO_5S.mp4 3.188 (VBench calls it static: 24 moving pairs against 30 required); rainline shots 3.61 / 17.03 / 2.41
dead_footage.note: Intent-dependent. Only meaningful when the shot spec asked for motion; a locked-off shot must not be scored against this.

detail_collapse.calibratedOn: VYREALM_ANIME_HERO_5S.mp4 1.235 (clean); VYREALM_RAINLINE_TRAILER_1080P.mp4 4.026 at frame 35, the global maximum across all 360 frames and a genuine generative collapse
detail_collapse.note: Highest-confidence threshold measured. Refine with the co-indexed frame difference: a big drop with rgbMae above the shot median is a cut or camera move, not a model failure.

terminal_detail_decay.calibratedOn: VYREALM_ANIME_HERO_5S.mp4 0.504 (696.8 / 1382.3); the same tail ramp appears in all four Wan2.2 shots measured
terminal_detail_decay.note: Expected to fire on every current Wan2.2 shot. That is the finding, not a miscalibration: the repair is a free tail trim.

morphing_geometry.calibratedOn: VYREALM_ANIME_HERO_5S.mp4 0.954 (min 0.808); rainline shots 0.951 / 0.809 / 0.951, with 0.809 the shot every other metric also condemns
morphing_geometry.note: Unanimous with five other metrics on which rainline shot is broken, which is why it survives despite single-clip calibration.

scene_drift.note: Histogram proxy for a dimension that properly needs an embedding model. torch does not load on this box (WinError 1455), so the real detector is unavailable, not merely expensive.

motion_roughness.note: Linear-blend stand-in for AMT. Ranks synthetic flicker below a synthetic pan in the probe self-check, which is the only ordering claim it has earned.

colour_oversaturation.calibratedOn: VYREALM_ANIME_HERO_5S.mp4 saturationExtremeFrac mean 0.15575, max 0.17833, with mean HSV saturation climbing +13.53 over the clip. The 0.13645 / 0.15744 pair quoted in the taxonomy is the stricter S == 255 fraction, a DIFFERENT quantity from the S >= 250 metric gated here, and must not be read as this metric's calibration.
colour_oversaturation.note: Fires on our current output by design: the oversaturation is real and measured. Set the permanent fix with a CFG sweep, not by moving this number.

colour_drift.note: Two clips, one separation. Telemetry to collect across about 30 human-labelled shots before hardening.

stepped_cadence.calibratedOn: VYREALM_ANIME_HERO_5S.mp4 2.6344 (lag1 -0.813, lag2 +0.875, flow alternation 5.27); VYREALM_RAINLINE_TRAILER_1080P.mp4 1.11 as a clean negative control
stepped_cadence.note: Measurement is reliable, the VERDICT is not: animating on twos is correct craft for anime. Drop this mode from the thresholds for anime shots rather than trusting the number.

encode_blocking.note: Measures the encoder, not the generator. Single-clip separation with no replication; collect, do not enforce.

scoring.note: Scores measure the DELIVERED file, compositing and encoding included. Thresholds are provisional; each carries its own calibratedOn and confidence.

receipts.note: No pixels were generated by this module. Every frame derives from the supplied source shots at their original timing.

lint.message: 15s sits in the 1-30s band, the weakest measured for Instagram Reels. Best observed: 45-60s.

scoring.reasoning: reroll: scene_drift (stability.histCorrFirstFrame.min -0.002487048234156611 vs threshold 0.55); colour_oversaturation (artefacts.saturationExtremeFrac.mean 0.30046728287894375 vs threshold 0.12). No post-pass repair recovers scene_drift, and the 1568 s re-roll fits an unbounded GPU budget.
